description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2022: A Coupled Geomechanics-Reliability Framework to Evaluate Closure and Damage Risk for Highway Assets Subject to Geohazard Impacts is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Alomir Favero, Bucknell University (bucknell.edu). Natural hazards are arguably the main threat to infrastructure in many countries. Transportation infrastructure (like roads and railroads) is particularly vulnerable to geohazards such as landslides and earth mass movements. Coverage: Washington, D.C.. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fcqv-ck93. Keywords: Risk Analysis Framework, Landslides, Highway Assets, SPH Method, Reliability. Published 2023-03-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
